The '''HPV-200 Hover Shopper''' was a small, one-person [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] designed for shopping and running errands in big [[City/Legends|cities]] or marketplaces. It was little more than a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and a comfortable seat. It had a secure cargo basket mounted on the back.

It was popular with the middle class as a way to avoid the hassle of mass transit. Some [[Technician/Legends|techs]] were known to upgrade the speeder by mounting a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike's]] engine to the chassis. This doubled the performance, but made it more expensive and harder to control.
